body:
I also tried adding nodes like crazy in a new project with the addons mentioned above.
No crashes.
But as mentioned, sometimes there are hours of work without crashes, sometimes only minutes inbetween without big difference in "Node-add"-usage

I am now able to reproduce it and can narrow it down to:
- Create a new Script that inherits from a `BehaveNode` or descendants with a class_name
- Add node (this crashes directly or...)
- Search for the new node / class name -> Crash

I will upload an MRP when i'm home later where this happens every time now (basically an empty project with the beehave plugin added and activated)
I am unsure atm if this is a problem of beehave or the editor.

I updated the initial post with an mrp.

Basically it looks like this happens with named classes that inherit from tool classes on their inital rendering in the "Create New Node"
The beehave addon was just a coincidence bc. it uses tool annotated named classes.

I can reproduce this crash pretty consistensly, though sometimes it just works. If i restart editor then, i will get into crashes.

I tried reproducing it with Godot 4.3 but did *not* get crashes, so this seems to be introduced with 4.4

I tried the other versions and the issue seems to begin with 4.4.dev7 
Thats as much as i can do from my side atm.

Thanks a lot, I can reproduce the issue with the MRP and the steps you outlined.
I also confirm the regression seems to have been introduced in 4.4.dev7.

I don't have time to bisect right now, anyone motivated is welcome to try it, just let others know on the issue.

Here's the results of the bisection:

```
80d11500b556259ddb5b9d4548a0922a5ac1cc92 is the first bad commit
commit 80d11500b556259ddb5b9d4548a0922a5ac1cc92 (HEAD, refs/bisect/bad)
Author: Danil Alexeev <dalexeev12@yandex.ru>
Date:   Sat Dec 14 21:25:05 2024 +0300
    Code Editor: Add documentation tooltips
```

Seems #91060 added this regression. 
cc. @dalexeev

I can't reproduce it, but I would guess the error is here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5da6deaaca27f3d4ec5281d5b791408570919f15/editor/editor_help.cpp#L3716

This code assumes that if the class documentation specifies a parent class, then it exists. I had some doubts about this, but I left it unchecked, since I copied it from here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5da6deaaca27f3d4ec5281d5b791408570919f15/editor/editor_help.cpp#L1020

P.S. Akien confirmed it above.
